Reasoning: This release stage is represented conjunctively: keep the panda_fingertip position fixed, keep its current orientation fixed, and open the gripper. The fixed-position constraint covers the requirement for no commanded end-effector linear motion while releasing at the current stack-release pose. The fixed-orientation constraint covers preserving the current tool +z and +y directions and no commanded angular motion. The open_gripper term encodes opening both fingers until the gripper-opened state is reached. The manipulator_low_effort condition is included with the fixed-position term to represent monitoring for no unexpected end-effector contact or effort spike during release. Unrepresented details: exact left/right finger joint positions and finger squeeze effort drop are not directly expressible beyond open_gripper/gripper_opened, and maintaining cube_2's independent object pose on cube_1 cannot be separately encoded because the API has no free-object hold operator and only one position operator is allowed in the stage.
